title: Variable format string (cpp) — review required
description: A cpp formatting call uses a variable as its format string: syslogs*([^,]+,s*[A-Za-z_]w*s*). Conversion specifiers in the value read and write process memory. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the value is fixed or passes it as an argument.
remediation: Use a fixed format string (a fixed "%s" format) and pass the value as an argument.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches variable-only calls; fixed formats with variable arguments never match.
